# Water Damage Endorsement WD-17

## Added Protection

Water backup sublimit: $10,000 per occurrence.

The water backup sublimit applies to loss caused by water that backs up through sewers, drains, or sump systems.

## Plumbing Discharge

Sudden and accidental discharge from a household plumbing system remains covered under Coverage A and Coverage C when the discharge is not repeated seepage.

This endorsement does not reduce the Coverage A limit for a covered plumbing discharge.

## Exclusions Unchanged

Repeated seepage or leakage over a period of weeks, months, or years remains excluded.

Damage from flood, surface water, or tidal water remains excluded unless another endorsement applies.
